The 12 colour seasons

Seasonal colour analysis sorts natural colouring into 12 seasons using four traits: undertone, depth, contrast and chroma. Springs are warm and clear, Summers cool and soft, Autumns warm and muted, and Winters cool and clear.

spring

Light SpringLight, warm, fresh and clear.True SpringWarm, golden, clear and lively.Bright SpringClear, vivid and warm-leaning.

summer

Light SummerLight, cool and gently soft.True SummerCool, soft and rosy.Soft SummerMuted, cool and understated.

autumn

Soft AutumnWarm, soft, medium depth.True AutumnWarm, earthy and rich.Deep AutumnDeep, warm and rich.

winter

Deep WinterDeep, cool and dramatic.True WinterCool, crisp and high-contrast.Bright WinterClear, cool and high-contrast.
